Reports closed kernel.cas_object_* pipeline kinds, critical-kind lifecycle YAML

presence, composed pipeline_definition registry size vs expected, and a dangling

ref sample. Observability only — not a second mutation engine.



See docs/architecture/KERNEL_MUTATION_PIPELINE.md.

  JSON coverage report
  zqk system kernel-integrity report --format json

Usage:
  zqk system kernel-integrity report [flags]

Flags:
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
